coordinate_system.description: Fake longitude/latitude so web-map libraries (MapLibre, Leaflet) work unchanged. 1 pixel of the straightened source drawing (reference/kelnara-original-straightened.png, 1600x2370) = 0.001 degrees. Kept near the equator so distortion is negligible.

scale.note: From the hand-drawn scale bar (0-688 km = 173 px). Real-world distance helpers (turf.distance etc.) will be wrong; multiply their km by world_km_per_real_km.

detail_levels.note: Every feature's 'minzoom' is a detail level. Map zoom = base_zoom + level. Levels 0-4 are the world/region scale, 5-12 are city scale.

levels.0: continent: land, sea, mountains, capitals, highways, province + sea names
levels.1: region: forests, rivers, cities, roads, region names
levels.6: city districts, major POIs inside cities
levels.7: farms, mills, named buildings; generated fields and secondary streets

travel.source: '1 day = 39 km' on the map legend; horse and cart are suggestions
travel.note: Walking speed depends on the ground: 46 km/day on a road (the road from the Emerald Citadel's gate to the Northern Outpost, 649 km, is about 14 days), 33 on a path, 39 across open country (the map legend). Distances from a city are measured from outside its gate.
